title: Indian-origin footballer Krissh Mahatma, 18, shot dead outside US restaurant
summary_full: Eighteen-year-old footballer Krissh Mahatma has been shot dead outside a taco restaurant in Jackson, Mississippi, just months after moving from London to pursue his football career in the United States. The Co-Lin Wolves striker was reportedly caught up in an argument that escalated into gunfire. A 22-year-old suspect has been arrested and charged with murder.
